note: LB.7b identity fixture (legacy-only, no matrix cell). A PHP top-level type in a namespace-less file or under the statement form `namespace X;` is directory-scoped (the LB.2 rule): HEAD doubles the file stem there (src::Billing::Invoice::Invoice::total, src::Legacy::LegacyThing::LegacyThing::go). The braced `namespace X { }` form does not double and keeps its namespace scope (App::Braced::Report): a braced file may hold several namespaces, and directory scope would merge their same-named classes. Top-level functions keep the file scope (control).
